title: Three things we
noticed about Beauty Republic
Three things
we noticed
about Beauty Republic
sections.kicker: Prepared for Beauty Republic by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Beauty Republic sells many brands. The front door shows one of them.
sections.keep: Your lavender script logo. It is the only thing on the page that looks like Beauty Republic.

pins.what: The first screen is entirely another company's name and product.
pins.why: A visitor cannot tell why to shop at Beauty Republic and not buy from the brand directly. The store disappears behind its supplier.
pins.how: Say why this shelf: what you pick, what you leave out, for whom.
pins.label: Your hero
pins.cost: The store is treated as a delivery service for other brands.

pins.what: Your logo is a soft, light lavender script. The section headline below the banner is heavy navy serif capitals.
pins.why: The two voices do not know each other. The logo says gentle and the headline says newspaper.
pins.how: Pick one voice and set both in it.
pins.label: Your type
pins.cost: The store has no single voice for people to recognise.

pins.area: Amber bottles on warm stone with blue wildflowers fill the hero photograph
pins.what: The photo of amber bottles on warm stone with blue wildflowers is the best image on the page. It belongs to the supplier.
pins.why: It shows the taste a store could have. The store has no photographs of its own.
pins.how: Shoot your own shelf with this same care.
pins.label: Your photos
pins.cost: Every brand you sell can look better on its own channels than it does in your store.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Beauty Republic's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Sephora, from another category. The store has a point of view, and the brands sit inside it.
